title: Right, and it still lost
prompt: It is 09:48 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: Another trending day. Read it the way you would any other. Some well-made trades lose, and what you're scored on is how you made it.
intro.advanced: 09:48 ET. Read it and decide. The result is not the question.

whyNot.label: skipping it because it can fail
whyNot.why: Every setup can fail. This one had liquidity taken, displacement, a defined entry and a draw. Passing on it because the outcome is uncertain is what a process is for.

whyNot.label: treating the loss as a flaw in the read
whyNot.why: The stop sat where the idea was proven wrong, and price proved it wrong. That's the system working as designed: a -1R loss on a sound setup.

reference.summary: A valid long (sweep, displacement, retrace into the gap, previous day high as the draw) that fails after entry. The stop sits where the idea is invalidated and takes the loss: -1R on a trade made correctly.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H; the overnight dip was a pullback in that trend.

decision.why: Every ingredient of a valid long is present. Taking it is correct whatever happens next; waiting for the retrace is equally sound.

take.why: The setup is valid. It can still lose.

draw.why: The previous day high is the pool above.

location.why: Against yesterday's range price is already past equilibrium after the open; the discount was the overnight dip.

annotations.label: Overnight low 19,831.5
annotations.why: Sell-side liquidity, swept at the open.

annotations.label: Previous day high 19,970.25
annotations.why: The pool above and the draw.

annotations.label: Sweep low 19,815.75
annotations.why: The extreme of the sweep, and the invalidation: price trading below it proves the idea wrong.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG from the displacement
annotations.why: The displacement left a gap and closed through the last 5m high: the entry model.

annotations.label: 5m order block under the gap
annotations.why: The last down candle before the displacement; an acceptable alternative area.

confluences.label: Displacement closing above the last 5m high
Entry area is the displacement's FVG
confluences.why: A defined area with a close stop.

confluences.label: "It will probably work out"
confluences.why: A hope is not a confluence. The decision rests on what's on the chart.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed above the last 5m high

lookFor: A losing trade with the right bias, liquidity read and entry is a normal failed setup. Don't change a sound process because of one result.
The stop is the cost of finding out. Place it where the idea is wrong, and accept the loss when price shows it.
